call_points.text: Targeting AUM of ₹9,000 Cr to ₹10,000 Cr by FY28.
Monthly disbursements averaged ₹500 Cr in Q4FY26, up from ₹400 Cr in Q3 and ₹300 Cr in Q2.
Aims to add 7 lakh new borrowers in FY27, targeting a customer base of 1.6 million.
Cost of borrowings expected to stay below 12.5% on a blended basis in FY27.
Opex to AUM targeted to reach 7% to 8% in the medium term.
X-bucket collection efficiency targeted at >= 99.5% regardless of book growth.

operating_notes.text: Issued up to 5,00,000 NCDs including a green shoe option of 2,00,000 NCDs aggregating to ₹500 crore at 11.25% p.a. interest.
As of March 31, 2026, the company received ₹199.35 crore out of the ₹400 crore rights issue.
80% of current AUM is constituted under new risk guardrails.
Marginal cost of borrowings reduced by 120 bps QoQ to 12.0% in Q4FY26.

timeline.summary: Spandana Sphoorty approved issuing up to ₹500 crore of secured NCDs at 11.25% p.a.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹259.69 Cr, net profit ₹5.27 Cr (against a loss of ₹434.3 Cr a year earlier).
Spandana Sphoorty reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹5 crore and a 12% QoQ increase in AUM to ₹4,420 crore.
Spandana Sphoorty filed the monitoring agency report for the rights issue for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Vinay Prakash Tripathi, Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited’s compliance officer, uploaded Q4 & FY26 conference call audio recording on May 5, 2026, per SEBI Regulation 30.
Spandana Sphoorty held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding to an exit AUM of ₹6,500 Cr by FY27 backed by 99.7% X-bucket collection efficiency.
Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited’s shareholders via postal ballot approved Mr. Neeraj Swaroop’s appointment as Independent Director on October 13, 2026, with 99.21% voting in favor.
Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited scheduled Q2 & H1FY27 earnings conference call on Friday, 30 October 2026 at 06:30 PM IST.
